propositions: Clients using the rebar CLI without a rebar checkout encounter dead links in CLI-served guides because internal cross-references use consumer-relative paths that don't resolve offline.
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT from verify_commit.py) has no CLI-discoverable home; it is only documented in rebar verify-commit-ticket --help with no guide-registry entry.
Packaged guides must repoint all dangling references to either sibling guides via rebar explain <topic> or repo docs via https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/ URLs.
A new packaged guide commit-ticket-trailer.md must be created, registered in AUTHOR_GUIDES, and served via rebar explain commit-trailer to provide offline trailer format discovery.
A guard test must enforce that no packaged guide contains consumer-relative link targets; only https://, http://, #anchors, and mailto: are allowed, preventing future regressions.
The MCP explain_criterion tool and all documentation must be updated to list commit-trailer alongside plan and review as discoverable guides.
